notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff and Presence of Gond attached to the same creature.
The creature does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Elf Warrior token, adding one mana of any color.
The creature with Thornbite Staff equipped triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
